What’s the purpose?. There’s a fact here. Apple has this feature built into the iOS since iOS 11 and the interface and the sound selection is much better.

I’m struggling to see the purpose for this app. Why would someone clone something that was available on every device for 2 years?

The interface design is too much and there’s no UX idea behind it. Buttons are all over the place and you have open multi menus to change alarms or sounds. And some parts of the interface is just out of reach for single hand use late at night.
The top half of the interface should have been cosmetic or reserved for statistical infos, instead of the placeholder for the play button for sound combinations or changing the timers.

I don’t know if the developer has plans to make this a paid or freemium app, but this app, at this stage, isn’t worth your time even for free.
You have this functionality on your iPhone or iPad already for a much higher quality and less headaches.

True sleep tracking is only possible with new generation of Apple Watches.
